A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RACO study. Their main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A-D are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original Reddit Summary and BeaverTails alignment experiments, comparative results, clipping ablations, and generated-response case studies in Section 4 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments, numerical results, ablations, and appendix case studies.

M1.justification: The objective-specific preference losses, weighted CAGrad correction, coefficient clipping, and update rule in Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. The new limitations do not modify the method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Reddit Summary quality-conciseness and quality-faithfulness, and BeaverTails helpfulness-harmlessness. The appendix examples and represented test scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Figures 2-4 and Table 2 retain AMoPO and DPO LW, with the same pre-alignment references where shown. The clipping ablations retain CAGrad, and Remark B.7 retains the same gradient-descent comparison.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendices C.2-C.3 retain the same sample counts, model configurations, weight sweeps, metrics, training settings, decoding parameters, and GPT-5.1 judging protocol. No experimental procedure is revised.

E4.justification: The clipping ablations and correction-radius sensitivity analysis in Figures 5-6, the toy example in Remark B.7, and all four Appendix C.1 case studies are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests for the experiments. The added discussion of gradient variance concerns missing stochastic theory, not empirical uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: The curves in Figures 2-6, Table 2 values, Remark B.7 results, and appendix generations are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains Qwen3-4B-Instruct win rates of 63.86% against DPO LW and 78.92% against AMoPO at helpfulness weight 0.2.

T1.justification: The definitions, Theorems 3.1-3.2, and Appendix B derivations and proofs remain unchanged. The added 'm=2 case' label restates an existing restriction; the new limitations clarify scope without revising formal assumptions or results.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about reward-free conflict handling, preference-weight preservation, Pareto-critical convergence, two-objective acceleration, and empirical trade-offs.

C2.justification: A new limitations discussion at the end of Appendix A clarifies that Pareto criticality does not imply global optimality, the deterministic proof does not establish minibatch-SGD convergence, and sample-complexity, consistency, and generalization guarantees are absent. These qualify the existing theory; empirical interpretations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 adds an 'Implementation & Model Checkpoint' section announcing code and RACO/baseline checkpoint releases with access links, absent from v1. It specifies that only checkpoints judged safe by the authors are released. Existing implementation details remain unchanged; external artifact availability is not established by inspecting the PDFs.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are retained. Changes to the Chen references update titles or publication information, while the Haimes entry corrects authorship metadata; these do not introduce new related work.

P1.justification: v3 makes limited heading edits, adds short release and limitations passages, labels Appendix B.1's two-objective case, and updates publication and bibliography metadata. The main narrative and section ordering remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 3 moves higher on page 6, the unchanged toy-results table moves from page 19 to page 20, and appendix case-study boxes acquire different page breaks. Figures, axes, legends, captions, and table structures otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 improves transparency by explicitly identifying the deterministic proof's limits and supplies code/checkpoint access information missing from v1. These are useful documentation gains, although the minibatch-theory gap remains, only a selected checkpoint subset is announced, and the methods, proofs, and empirical evidence are unchanged.
